module: Public invitation endpoint IP rate limit

finding.scenario: Cleanup removes an expired IP bucket while an allowed request is waiting on that bucket mutex. The request then appends into the detached bucket; its next request gets a new empty bucket and bypasses the active-window budget. Cleanup also deleted outside the bucket lock.
finding.before: The actual cleanup callback body was extracted unchanged into cleanupExpired(cutoff) to avoid a two-minute timer in the test. A one-P controlled old-bucket waiter reproducer failed all five runs before the behavioral change; live-budget control passes. .git/module-audit-20261113/public-auth-cleanup-before.log
finding.fix: Retire buckets under the same lock as request accounting; waiting requests verify the map still references their bucket before consuming budget and otherwise retry. Timestamp sampling now occurs under the lock.

validation.controls: Includes 100 concurrent callers with cleanup; retained live budgets, expired bucket eviction, independent/unknown IP buckets, and actual Gin middleware sharing its 30-request budget across the two invite endpoints.

limits: Local process limiter semantics only, matching existing deployment behavior; no claim of shared cross-replica budgeting.
No live request traffic generated. Background cleanup timer cadence unchanged.
